results.title: Capsule networks for intelligent fault diagnosis: a roadmap ...
results.content: # Capsule networks for intelligent fault diagnosis: a roadmap of recent advancements and challenges. Against the backdrop of the rapid development of intelligent fault diagnosis (IFD) technology, Capsule Networks (CapsNets), owing to their ability to preserve spatial hierarchical information and enhance interpretability, have emerged as a promising alternative to traditional convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and thus become a research hotspot in the field of IFD. comprehensive feature integrated capsule network. Wavelet Capsule Generative Adversarial Network. Capsules network combined with the Xception. U-Net with capsule network. Multi-scale spatial–temporal CapsNet. A deep capsule neural network with data augmentation generative adversarial networks. dual-path convolution with attention mechanism and capsule network. Deep capsule graph convolutional network. Auto-encoder and capsule network. Convolutional block attention capsule network. Multi-Scale Residual Generative Adversarial Network. Local temporal self-similarity coupled with bag-of-words CapsNet. Capsule network based on wide convolution and multi-scale convolution. MsR-GAN and feature enhancement-driven CapsNet. One-dimensional training interference capsule neural network. Efficient feature-focused lightweight capsule network.
